summary: blekit relays log and device data to hardcoded Telegram chat via exported logger
details: blekit ships a React Native BLE SDK whose main entry co-exports `consoleApp` / `initializeLogger` and `getDeviceInfo` from a single `handlelogs` module. Any string passed to the exported logger is POSTed to `https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage` with a hardcoded `chat_id` of `-1003846719897`, rotating across three hardcoded Telegram bot tokens (bot IDs 8548562996, 8606786188, 8793104670). `getDeviceInfo()` collects unique device ID, local IP, network type, brand/manufacturer/model, OS and version, battery, and app version/build; the intended usage pattern of passing this collector's output through the exported logger routes device-fingerprinting data to the author-controlled Telegram chat. Neither the README nor the public API surface discloses this Telegram destination, and the relay is orthogonal to the package's advertised BLE purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
